about: How the avatar moves when it isn't emoting (fabric/tools/blender/moves.py; played by RobloxAvatarRenderer). axis: what t (0..1) runs along: phase (the walk cycle: right foot forward at 0, left at 0.5), time (a loop of loopSeconds), pitch (where you look: 0 up, 0.5 ahead, 1 down), progress (once through: a pickaxe swing; jumping, from going up to falling fast).

rows.name: Walking
rows.note: Heel to toe with soft knees, arms swinging the other way

rows.name: Running
rows.note: Sprinting: knees up, heels kick back, arms pumping

rows.name: Crouching
rows.note: Sneaking: low on bent knees, leaning in

rows.name: Sneaking
rows.note: Creeping along, low and leaning in

rows.name: Jumping and falling
rows.note: Knees tucked going up, legs reaching for the ground coming down, spread out falling fast

rows.name: Swimming
rows.note: Front crawl: one arm reaching, one pulling, legs kicking

rows.name: Treading water
rows.note: Head up, hands sculling in front, legs cycling

rows.name: Climbing
rows.note: Up a ladder: hand over hand, knee over knee

rows.name: Gliding
rows.note: Both hands up on the glider's grips, legs dangling

rows.name: Aiming
rows.note: Holding a gun where you look (here: up, ahead, then down)

rows.name: Pickaxe swing
rows.note: Wound up over the shoulder, a big chop, follow through

rows.name: Healing
rows.note: Bandages and med kits: hands together in front, wrapping

rows.name: Drinking
rows.note: Shield potions, Slurp Juice and the Chug Jug: the drink to the mouth, head back

rows.name: Reviving
rows.note: Down on one knee by a knocked teammate, both hands working on them

rows.name: Rebooting
rows.note: At the Reboot Van's screen, typing

rows.name: Searching a chest
rows.note: Bent over it, rummaging with both hands

rows.name: Knocked down
rows.note: Crawling on the belly: one arm reaches ahead along the ground while the other pulls back, legs push
